Name: (AT) Hat Paintings
Author: VinillaBean
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS]~ Summer 2023 - The Season of the Hat Mouse ~

This was created as an entry into the mod contest for the Stardew Valley Discord server's event!

[size=4]Content
[/size][/font][font=Trebuchet MS]This mod adds paintings of people wearing the various hats that appear in the game, replacing the [b]Sun #44[/b] painting.
[/font][font=Trebuchet MS]
The first version (1.0.0) only contains the hats sold by the one and only Hat Mouse. Future updates will hopefully add in all the missing ones!

[size=4]Installation and Removal
[/size]1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] if you haven't already, this mod won't work without it!
2. Download this mod.
3. Unzip and put the file where you put the rest of your Stardew Valley mods in your Mods folder.
4. Launch game!
(5. If you have decided that you'd no longer like to use this mod,  all you've gotta do is delete the file from the Mods folder! Easy as that.)

Check out my [url=https://ko-fi.com/vinilla]ko-fi[/url] or [url=https://vinillavin.neocities.org/]neocities[/url] if you enjoyed my mod! Thanks for checking it out~
[/font][font=Trebuchet MS]
Thanks to my friends from the SDV Discord server for encouraging me![/font]
